text:
carmen: heads-up — trying the quickstart and hitting a weird first-call failure when running the docker image on Docker Desktop. UI shows a spinning retry and then "Tenant not authorized". local node run works fine.

eduardo: can you paste the response body? is it a 401/403 or our tenant_blocked?

carmen: response is 403 with body:
```json
{"error":"Tenant not authorized","code":"tenant_blocked","note":null}
```
molly: interesting. i noticed our new sample has an "auto-detect" mode where SDK tries to read cloud metadata to pick a workspace header. in containers on docker-desktop that metadata call times out and we end up sending no X-Redwood-Org header. the gateway routes to anonymous tenant and that often is billing-locked.

infra-lee: confirm — container networking in some setups blocks metadata IP. the sample shouldn't silently switch to anonymous. that's a DX trap.

carmen: exactly. no hint in UI that org header missing. took me 10 mins to try curl locally and compare headers.

eduardo: proposal: 1) sample app should validate effective auth headers on startup and emit a clear error if neither REDWOOD_ORG nor cloud metadata produced an org id (include console link). 2) SDK should detect tenant_blocked and, if no org header was set, include an actionable hint in the error payload.

molly: for the SDK change we can add a small field in the error.message string (not new structured field) to avoid API churn: e.g. append " Hint: set REDWOOD_ORG or ensure X-Redwood-Org is supplied. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing" when tenant_blocked and headers absent.

infra-lee: sample entrypoint check idea (bash):
```bash
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ORG" ] && [ -z "$CLOUD_METADATA_DISABLED" ]; then
  echo "\u26a0\ufe0f No workspace configured: set REDWOOD_ORG or disable auto-detect. Quickstart will otherwise route to an anonymous workspace which can be billing-gated. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces"
fi
```

carmen: could we also change the UI to stop the infinite spinner and show a short, actionable card: "Request blocked: workspace requires billing setup. Visit workspace billing or set REDWOOD_ORG"?

eduardo: UI change is fine, but lower priority. i'm going to add a unit/integration test to the SDK that simulates metadata timeout and missing header to assert the new hint appears.

molly: i'll open a tiny PR to the quickstart repo for the startup validation + README note about Docker Desktop metadata caveat. infra-lee can you add the entrypoint echo?

infra-lee: yup. i'll also add a note to our quickstart CI matrix to run the docker image with metadata endpoint blocked to catch regressions.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-11z requires a billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-11z/billing to add payment/contact info.

carmen: after passing REDWOOD_ORG the sample works. thanks for the fast triage.

devex: filing follow-ups: sdk-hint-on-tenant-block, quickstart-auto-detect-validate, onboarding-email-billing-hint. we'll link PRs and add a short blurb in the welcome flow: "If your first call fails, check REDWOOD_ORG and billing settings."

eduardo: low-risk changes, good DX improvement. i'll own the SDK test and PR.

molly: will include a short paragraph in the quickstart README about cloud metadata pitfalls (Codespaces, Docker Desktop, CI).

infra-lee: PRs incoming. closing loop when merged. :rocket:
